rows.text: Regulation Article 3: without prejudice to Article 1 of the Law, membership lasts four years, not renewable, from the date set in the royal order appointing the member; exceptionally it may be renewed if the member's brothers agree, with the King's approval.

rows.role_title: رئيس هيئة البيعة — Chairman of the Allegiance Commission
rows.text: Regulation Article 4: a breach of membership duties is investigated by a committee of three members chosen by the Commission's chairman; removal needs two-thirds of the members and is referred to the King.

bounded_scope: Chair observations for CLAUDE-C01-25 only (sa_shura_chair and sa_succession_chair).
